`solve_model` still starts from `n.snapshots`, and `_as_model_snapshots` only converts a MultiIndex to flat form when the model is flat; it does not generally recover the model’s stored representation. For example, if a model is built with MultiIndex snapshots and the network’s snapshots are subsequently replaced with a single-level index, `solve_model` passes that single-level index unchanged to `extra_functionality`, despite the model having been built with a MultiIndex.
